summary: Frontend-only testing completed for 6-tab navigation and pure view separation. All 6 tabs (Reader, TOC, Surgeon View, NoteLab, Study, Syllabus) render correctly with proper data-testid attributes. Each tab shows its pure view without UI bleed from other modes. PDF upload works in Reader view. TOC shows empty state with 'Add Chapter Manually' option. Surgeon View shows empty state with features list. NoteLab shows filters sidebar. Study tab shows 'Ready to Study?' with card stats. Syllabus tab shows 'Create Your Study Plan' with upload option.

issues: Excessive console logging - TOC extraction callback fires repeatedly (100+ times) after PDF load. This is a performance concern but doesn't affect functionality.

action_items: MINOR: Fix excessive TOC extraction callback firing in SmartPDFViewer - the onOutline callback is being called repeatedly causing console spam
critical_code_review_comments: All 6 navigation tabs have proper data-testid attributes (nav-reader, nav-toc, nav-surgeon, nav-notelab, nav-study, nav-syllabus)
Pure view components (PureReaderView, PureTocView, PureSurgeonView, PureNoteLabView, StudySessionPanel, SyllabusModePanel) render correctly without UI bleed
Guest mode (NEXT_PUBLIC_DISABLE_GOOGLE_SIGNIN=1) works correctly - mock user created on load
localStorage persistence working for session state and Surgeon View data
PDF upload and viewing works correctly in Reader mode
TOC auto-generation from PDF outline works (1 chapter extracted from sample.pdf)
Empty states are properly displayed for all views when no data exists
seed_data_creation: None required - testing empty states and tab navigation
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 tabs are working correctly with pure view separation. The main refactoring to remove legacy Pattern view and TOCSidebar was successful. Firebase is MOCKED using localStorage. To test full functionality: (1) Upload a PDF in Reader, (2) Switch to Surgeon View to create highlights, (3) Check NoteLab for captured highlights, (4) Use Study tab to review, (5) Create syllabus in Syllabus tab. Minor issue: SmartPDFViewer onOutline callback fires excessively after PDF load.
